name: CAINCA
key_symptoms: Pain in region of kidneys; better lying bent backward. General fatigue.
guiding_symptoms: Pain in region of kidneys; better lying bent backward. General fatigue.
urinary_symptoms: Constant desire to urinate. Polyuria while travelling. Urine fiery. Burning pain in urethra, especially glandular portion.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Pain in region of kidneys; better lying bent backward. General fatigue.
